summary.en: Prior to the current scene, Sonoko sends messages proposing an emergency meeting with other girls including Ayumi, Haibara, Sato, and Ran as she was informed about a ninja-themed event that might smell like an upcoming crime by her acquaintance. Before the five can get there, they must first dress in like a kunoichi and take the walkie talkie. The five are currently tracking a woman wearing a similar costume to them but Sato suddenly changes the target to a man wearing it for some reason. The pursuit continues on that man until they realize that many people are actually wearing the costume for the said event, making the stakeout meaningless, so Sonoko suggests having tea somewhere. There, they group is discussing about the event, with some notable details here: This event attracts a lot of people to engage just for the big gift, however, some of its missions do have legal problems. The page dedicated to show other ninja current positions shows the strange trend of why they are focusing on the East of Beika city while the staff are doing something in the West. Coincidentally, the precious Kingscote crown made by a famous goldsmith is being displayed at Kaneko Jewelry store (you again?) under the protection of the reinforced frame, anti-theft glasses, two guard robots and drones, and four security cameras. So Sonoko suggests going to that store, only to see the owner Keita Kaneko bound and gagged when they arrive. In addition, the crown is taken away by someone like usual, well at least it wasn't due to the flaw of the new security systems bought by Kaneko himself. Location: Kaneko Jewelry Store, Beika Town Victim: Keita Kaneko Stolen items: Kingscote Crown The robber also bind and gag Kaneko. He fells unconscious after being found by the five. While they leave the case for the police to solve, they’d still spread smoke by posting fake news to create invisible blockades for the robber(s). Later, Haibara receives a direct message from the culprit asking the reason why she knows so much about those proclaimed blockades, to which she explains it was from police communication channels and suggests going by train from Beika station. Next, Sato will calls for Takagi and the others for the ambush while the group will keep track of the unknown thief(s).
